scope: Whole 8 km AOI: 256 tiles + overview + viewer (?diag=1) with the same 10 inspection buttons
changes_since_full_B7: approach ramps end where DSM - DTM < 0.4 m (was 0.8 m). Evidence for CD_BROWSER_CHECK_008 inspection 8: in the full_B7 compressed GLB the ramp top fell 22.26 -> 21.63 m in 12 m while the ordinary road beyond was at 22.24 m (0.6 m dip + step); in full_B8 the ramp top is 22.26-22.27 m for 14 m and the road beyond 22.24 m (output/data/inspection8_profile.json, measured from web/tiles/t12_07_base.glb)

the wall-like faces at that bridge end are the sides/end of the inferred ramp solid standing on the DTM, which drops to 14.57 m under the bridge end (EA DTM removes the bridge structure) and recovers to 22.1 m 14 m further on; the ordinary road drawn on that DTM slope lies inside the solid
Clifton west approach: extra abutment width tapers from 11.4 m at the pylon to the 6.4 m road width at the outer end; ramp 49.9 m, ending at 80.37 m on the ground road

bridge_connection_check.not_verified: This compares model heights with each other. It does not verify real-world deck heights; connections are not individually inspected.

node_matching: nodes are way end points merged when their projected XY agree to 0.01 m (not matched by OSM node id; end points of the same OSM node always agree, the converse is assumed, not verified). Ways crossing at different levels without a common end point are never tied together.
not_passed_claims: The unresolved connections, the ramps steeper than 10%/15% and the ramps with an outer-end difference > 0.3 m in the crude test are NOT claimed as passed.
co_check_level: automatic checks on the final files (round trip 0 problems, drape 0 failures, web copies all_ok, bridge connection check) and the inspection-8 profile measured from the compressed GLB; not opened in a browser by CO; no offline render of full_B8
